video_title: Should Jalen Duren TURN DOWN a 100 Million Dollar DEAL 👀

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Duren's contract situation and his future in Detroit
quotes.excerpt: If you're Jalen Duren, get me the fuck up out of Detroit.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: If you are Jalen Duren, get me the fuck up out of Detroit. I need you to put your GM hat sometimes and understand. I need you to be the GM. Monty is going to take care of the partners. You need to be the GM and the person. Both of you. He has proved to me because the reason I go to CB is because CB was right. I thought Giannis would get traded during the year, but he said they did not have to do that because Milwaukee Bucks have the cards. They hold all the cards, right? So if I am Detroit Pistons, you are going to turn down all this money?

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: He has nowhere to go. Exactly. He cannot go to the Lakers. Cannot go to the Kings now. Are you saying sign the deal or are you saying play the year? Because he can play for 9.5 this year.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: Sign the fucking deal. Three-year deal, four-year deal, and then get me the fuck up out of here.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Debating the value of Jalen Duren's potential contract offer
quotes.excerpt: What are they offering him? Does anybody know? Has it come out yet?

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: What are they offering him? Does anybody know? Has it come out yet?

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: Thirty. Over a hundred. It was like 20 million a year. So it is like 20 million.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: It was more than 20 million. No, it is more than 20 million. It had to be at least what Walker Kessler got.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: Upside of a loan is going to give him 25 plus.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: They said no. And that is probably what he is thinking. That has got to be at least what Walker Kessler got.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: The market value of Jalen Duren's potential contract
quotes.excerpt: The man is eligible for 287 and you are talking about giving him 180?

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: The man is eligible for 287 and you are talking about giving him 180? You got to take the 100 million off the table.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: But Ray, you have to look at the market. No one can pay that.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: Nobody is going to pay that. So the market dictates your value.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: And his home team can sign him for more than anybody. So, but five years, it just looks better you are giving five years 200.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Evaluating Jalen Duren's playoff performance and contract value
quotes.excerpt: The playoff performance fucked him. Four years 130. 32.5 a year.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: The playoff performance fucked him. Four years 130. 32.5 a year. With the fourth year player option and a 15% kicker.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: I am probably giving him the same deal. He is looking to get traded. He wants the kicker.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: I am probably giving him around the same ballpark. Why? Because I got to get a better team around my guy. I have to build a better team. I got to have more money to build a team around in Detroit. I have to have the money to pay for Detroit. Because if I do not have the money, I am not just picking Detroit.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: James Harden's contract and playoff struggles
quotes.excerpt: This kid is trying to maximize. We all know that you are trying to maximize those windows.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: This kid is trying to maximize. We all know that you are trying to maximize those windows. He had a great year, not a good playoffs. If the best player did that, your ass is going to do that.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: But the best player already signed his deal.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: No, he chose to do that. And he did not take, he did not take no. James Harden set the blueprint, meaning he was the best player and took less.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: You are the second, but maybe the second or third.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: The financial reality of building a competitive NBA team
quotes.excerpt: The way the NBA is right now, I do not got to pay you.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: The way the NBA is right now, I do not got to pay you. And guess what? I cannot. If I want to compete and win, I cannot pay you. Or my team is not going to be that good. Because guess what? Just like how everybody is raving, mad as fuck about De'Aaron Fox, they cannot trade that motherfucker. Why? He makes too much money. Joel Embiid, the motherfucker always hurt, right? Why can't you trade him? He makes too much money.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: But you are going to tell me you cannot pay me. You said you cannot pay me, but the Lakers can pay, pay Kessler?

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Duren's contract leverage and the NBA market
quotes.excerpt: Let me go ahead and make 130 million right quick. I am going to go to work.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Let me go ahead and make 130 million right quick. I am going to go to work. I am going to earn that again.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: He is going to make more than 130.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: He can make more than 130.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: My only reason behind what he is probably doing is time. You do not have to sign the deal until October.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: The risk of Jalen Duren betting on himself
quotes.excerpt: If I am Detroit, all right, my nigga, you want to play for the 9.5?

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: If I am Detroit, all right, my nigga, you want to play for the 9.5? Because at the end of the day, if you prove, if you prove him, you do not want him walking for nothing. You cannot let him walk for anything, same point.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: Exactly, because the 9.5 is putting him into unrestricted free agency.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: The team's perspective on Jalen Duren's value
quotes.excerpt: It is not like we think Duren is a bad player. I think he is huge.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: We sitting here talking about it like we think, it is not like we think Duren is a bad player. No, I think he is huge. They need him. Yes. The problem is that he made third team All-NBA and that that jump for the contract is this. And now he wants it.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: And All-Star.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: Yeah. But it is the, it is the All-NBA, right? That that is the kicker.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: The potential financial impact of Jalen Duren's contract
quotes.excerpt: That might be one of the biggest drops in money we will ever see.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: That might be one of the biggest drops in money we will ever see. To have the possibility to get 200 and 87 million dollars. And then you might get 100 plus million off just because of the market.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: I have seen guys that have done bad, made bad decisions.
